scheme_name: SITARE-Gandhian Young Technological Innovation Award Grant
other_conditions: Must be an Indian student pursuing a Ph.D. or Master's degree in any discipline.
Must hold a valid ID issued by the Institution/University.
Must submit a No Objection Certificate (NoC) in the prescribed format.
Can receive the SITARE‑GYTI Award Grant only once.
Exceptional talent may be considered beyond the standard eligibility with approval from BIRAC.
benefits_summary: Grant-in-aid up to INR 15 lakhs, disbursed in milestone‑based installments, with continuous mentoring and support.
documents_required: Valid ID issued by the Institution/University.
No Objection Certificate (NoC) in the prescribed format.
